prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return ES module solution.ts.
Required API: export function liveCache(entries:string[][], now:number):string[]|null
Behavior: Each entry is key,value,writtenAt,ttl; keys match ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*. now, writtenAt and ttl must be integers in 0..10,000,000, and writtenAt+ttl must not exceed 10,000,000 when ttl is nonzero. Reject duplicate keys. ttl zero never expires; otherwise live exactly while now < writtenAt+ttl. Return key=value pairs in Unicode code-point key order.
Visible example: at now 15, a value written at 10 with ttl 5 is expired, while ttl 0 remains live.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: const f:(entries:string[][],now:number)=>string[]|null=(e,n)=>{const k=/^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/;if(!Number.isSafeInteger(n)||n<0||n>1e7)return null;const s=new Set<string>(),o:string[]=[];for(const x of e){if(x.length!==4||!k.test(x[0])||s.has(x[0])||!/^(?:0|[1-9]\d*)$/.test(x[2])||!/^(?:0|[1-9]\d*)$/.test(x[3]))return null;const w=Number(x[2]),t=Number(x[3]);if(w>1e7||t>1e7||(t&&w+t>1e7))return null;s.add(x[0]);if(t===0||n<w+t)o.push(x[0]+'='+x[1])}return o.sort()};export{f as liveCache};
